scope: current live daemon data availability and quarantined feature observability

live_collection.finding: The daemon is collecting raw odds, but safe joined evidence was blocked by official-result availability/join issues and identity quarantines.

official_results.root_cause: TheDogs official result rows can report promoted reserves under rugs 9/10 with a source '(from box N)' note while the frozen pre-jump participant remains at box N.
official_results.fix: Parser and forward-shadow join now remap only source-backed TheDogs reserve rugs 9/10 to a frozen participant box when the cleaned official dog name exactly matches the frozen participant.

quarantined_features.reason: Feature activation still lacks train coverage and a current report-only candidate metric comparison.

code_changes: scripts/ingest_results_for_date.py: source-backed promoted reserve remap before result validation, with accept/reject diagnostics
scripts/join_forward_shadow_results.py: same promoted reserve remap in forward-shadow join classification and identity reports
scripts/shadow_autopilot_v1.py: feature activation data-availability status with live same-distance provenance and blocker counts
scripts/shadow_autopilot_daemon.py: daemon summary pass-through for feature data-availability status

remaining_data_gaps.current: 0/751 train rows present for both watched same-grade timing features
remaining_data_gaps.required_next_step: Build a report-only historical training/eval packet with safe pre-race target grade/distance and strict prior-history provenance.

remaining_data_gaps.current: candidate metric comparison missing or stale versus the current 442-race aggregate
remaining_data_gaps.required_next_step: Run a fresh report-only challenger activation metric comparison after train coverage is nonzero and provenance passes.

remaining_data_gaps.current: raw odds are growing, but strict identity metadata still rejects many rows
remaining_data_gaps.required_next_step: Normalize odds race IDs and attach canonical race metadata/source URLs at ingest/join boundaries without weakening pre-jump timing checks.

remaining_data_gaps.current: latest live sibling daemon collected valid official result rows but same-cycle join still reported official_result_rows_not_present
remaining_data_gaps.required_next_step: In the runtime variant that has autonomous official result artifacts, route report-only valid official-result artifacts into the same-cycle join input without DB writes.

decision_rationale: The repair should reduce reserve-box quarantines in the current join/parser path and improve operator visibility into quarantined feature blockers. It does not activate the same-grade timing features, train, promote, write labels, mutate registries, or fabricate odds/EV.
